1.consolidated_definition: Descachazar, rebajar o desgastar alguna superficie. “La uña de la bestia se cachaza para herrarla.” La forma correcta es cachar. Dicc. Acad.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To wear down or erode some surface. "The hoof of the beast is worn down to shoe it." The correct form is cachar.
